subject: Declaring 2 QTLs on the same chromosome

messages.author: b8f0941d36b88136
messages.subject: Declaring 2 QTLs on the same chromosome
parts:
Hi Karl,
When do you declare two peaks on the same chromosome for the same trait as two QTLs ?  I have come across some papers which say more than 20 cM while others > 30 cM? Which one is right?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Declaring 2 QTLs on the same chromosome
parts:
I do not try to call multiple QTL on the basis of single-QTL genome scan by scanone.
I'd instead look at scantwo or multiple-QTL models with makeqtl/fitqtl/addqtl/stepwiseqtl.

Whether peaks < 20 cM or > 30 cM apart would be suggestive of multiple QTL depends on the type of cross, the sample size, and the strength of QTL effects. And it's just better to try to tease apart one vs two QTL in models that explicitly consider multiple QTL.

karl
